rules.pullback: base bar 45-70% below the highest 4h close so far (best 50-60%)
rules.quiet: 12 bars (2 days) ending at the base bar close inside a <=2.1x range; their avg volume <=50% of the busiest 2-day stretch
rules.volRising: within 6 days of the base: last 3 bars avg volume >=1.5x the base average and a close above the base high (and no more than 1.5x the old peak close: PRIORS volume arrived as it broke its old peak)
rules.cleanContract: GeckoTerminal: not honeypot, top-10 <=50%, dev <=10%, data present
rules.utility: website + product description (keyword evidence; confirm manually)

coiled.shipWhy: no grid cell had n >= 15 on the earlier split
coiled.label: experimental, did not beat random (failed the pre-declared test: no grid cell had n >= 15 on the earlier split)
coiled.preDeclared:
(fixed in this file before any result was seen; numbers in data/rh_scan.json -> coiled):
  base        = the 12 bars (2 days) ending 3 bars before the signal bar; "recent" = the last 3 bars
  context     = base-end close 45-70% below the highest close before it; base avg volume <= 50% of the
                busiest 2-day stretch; >= 3 days of history
  tightness T = base close range (max close / min close) <= T,       T in {1.15, 1.25, 1.35}
  volume    V = recent 3-bar avg volume / base avg volume >= V,       V in {1.3, 1.6, 2.0}
  position    = every recent close <= base top (max base close) and >= base low (min base low)
  dedupe      = one signal per token per 7 days (per grid cell)
  outcomes    = same as the Trigger replay: 2x before -30% from entry within 7 days (42 x 4h bars);
                -30% first; plus false alarm = no 4h close above the base top within 3 days (18 bars),
                and the plan stop (4h close under base low -2%) hit before 2x
  display     = if no cell is chosen, current candidates are shown with the middle cell (T=1.25, V=1.6), labelled experimental
  split       = median timestamp of the random-daily-entry sample (same tokens); earlier < split <= later
  selection   = on the EARLIER split only: among cells with n >= 15, max (hit% - drop%), ties -> larger n
  ship rule   = on the LATER split the chosen cell must have n >= 20 on >= 8 tokens AND
                (hit% - drop%) >= random-daily (hit% - drop%) + 5 points AND hit% > random hit%.
                Otherwise it is published only as 'experimental, did not beat random'.

baseline.what: one entry per day on the same tokens after day 3 (no pattern), same 2x-before--30% rule

backtest.win: best high >= 2x entry before any 4h low <= -30%
backtest.trigger: volume (last 3 bars) >=1.5x the base average AND close above the base high and no more than 1.5x the prior peak close, within 6 days of a base bar
caveats: Universe is today's survivors (pools still listed): dead tokens are missing, so results are biased upward.
Chain history is only weeks long; liquidity at signal time is unknown (today's is used for the filter).
Rules 4-5 (contract, utility) cannot be replayed historically; only price/volume rules 1-3 are tested.

strengthWhy: 61 triggers; 29.5% hit 2x before -30% vs baseline 19.8% (n=2385); survivor-biased universe

priorsCalibration.note: Rules were tuned on this one example (n=1), so PRIORS matching them proves nothing; the replay on other tokens is the test.

impostors.why: HOOKR copy "Hookr" created 2026-10-17 with ~$10.8M quoted liquidity and ~$5 volume: likely fake liquidity

sticky.note: every token that ever got a card stays on the board; ones the scanner can no longer score are listed under missing
